what_this_is: Assay scored against BenchGuard's 12 author-confirmed ScienceAgentBench defects. Every number under 'their_report' was computed by BenchGuard's eval/metrics.py from verdicts produced by BenchGuard's eval/match.py. Nothing in this file recomputes them.

gold_defect_presence.note: `already_fixed_upstream` means the split already contains BenchGuard's corrected wording, so no reader of that text can find the defect. `differs_from_both` is usually a transcription typo; check it by hand before treating it as either.

arm_detail.why_rejected: By Assay's own trivial-floor rule a detector that flags 60% of a benchmark has not earned its existence. Scored here only to measure what the rejection cost.
